name: cavemio-textarea
title: Textarea
description: A text box that eases to the height of what you write, scrolls with its own thin thumb and faded edges, and turns into a composer with tools, a send button and ⌘↵.

cavemio.accessibility:
- Shares field.tsx with every text control: one surface, one focus ring, one way of showing hints and errors.
- The thumb is decorative (aria-hidden); the textarea still scrolls with wheel, touch and keys.
- Reduced motion: the height changes at once.
cavemio.previewNote: Interactive local fixture. Data and async results are simulated in the preview; the caller supplies application services.

props.name: minRows / maxRows
props.description: 3 / 10 · Height range in lines; it scrolls past maxRows.

props.name: footer
props.description: – · Tools inside the box on the left.

props.name: action
props.description: – · The main action inside the box on the right.

props.name: onSubmit
props.description: – · Called on ⌘↵ / Ctrl+Enter when there is text.

props.name: maxLength
props.description: – · Limit; shows a rolling count beside the label.

props.name: showCount
props.description: true · Show the count when maxLength is set.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: – · The new text on every change.

props.name: ...textarea props
props.description: – · Everything a native textarea takes, including ref.

useCases.title: Comments and replies
useCases.description: A reply box with send inside it, and ⌘↵.

useCases.title: Bio and description fields
useCases.description: A limit with a count that warns before it stops you.

useCases.title: Feedback forms
useCases.description: Long answers that scroll after a few lines instead of taking the page.

useCases.title: Release notes and changelogs
useCases.description: Writing in a card without a fixed height.

features.title: Eased growth
features.description: The box eases to each new height in 260ms, between minRows and maxRows.

features.title: Scrolling that keeps the shape
features.description: No native scrollbar: a 3px thumb inside the padding and 14px edge fades, written to the elements with no render per scroll frame.

features.title: Composer mode
features.description: action (send) inside the box, footer for tools if you need them; onSubmit on ⌘↵ / Ctrl+Enter with a hint beside the action.

features.title: A count that rolls
features.description: Each digit rolls the way the count moved; amber in the last 10%, red at the limit.

features.title: No zoom on iPhone
features.description: 16px text on phones, the designed size from the sm breakpoint.

states.title: rest
states.description: minRows tall (3 by default) inside a 14px-radius thin line box.

states.title: growing
states.description: Each wrap eases the box to the mirror's height (260ms).

states.title: scrolling
states.description: Past maxRows: lines fade at the edges (14px), the thumb shows while scrolling and fades 0.9s after; drag it to scroll.

states.title: ready to send
states.description: With onSubmit and text, "⌘↵ to send" rises in beside the action.

states.title: near limit
states.description: With maxLength, the count turns amber at 90% and red at 100%.

states.title: error
states.description: Red line, the error replaces the hint, one shake.
